properties.headline: High Wind Watch issued October 13 at 11:21AM PDT until October 16 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 25 to 45 mph with gusts of 50 to 70 mph
possible.

* WHERE...Eastern San Gabriel Mountains, Interstate 5 Corridor, Santa
Susana Mountains, Western San Gabriel Mountains and Highway 14
Corridor, and Western Santa Monica Mountains Recreational Area.

* WHEN...From Thursday morning through Friday evening.

* IMPACTS...Damaging winds could blow down trees and power lines.
Widespread power outages are possible. Travel could be difficult,
especially for high profile vehicles.
properties.instruction:
Secure outdoor objects.

Avoid parking vehicles under trees.

Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Have a plan in place for possible power outages.

NWSheadline: HIGH WIND WATCH IN EFFECT FROM THURSDAY MORNING THROUGH FRIDAY EVENING
